test_title: PYST 28: SSC GD Constable 2022 - English (Held On : 23 Jan 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Dogs are the most adorable and lovable __beings to tie__.
solution:
The correct answer is **option (4).** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• In the given sentence, the underlined phrase **"beings to tie" **is not clear and seems to be an incomplete or nonsensical expression.
 
• When we replace it with **"pets to keep,"** the sentence becomes coherent and understandable.
 
• It conveys the idea that dogs are wonderful animals **to have as pets, which is a common sentiment.**
 
• The other options do not make any sense in this context.

Therefore, the correct sentence is* “Dogs are the most adorable and lovable **pets to keep.__**”*
